description: Utility class for setting up and verifying the status of a Consul cluster in tests, providing methods to ensure Consul is running and accessible.

classes.name: ConsulTestUtils
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for Consul test setup and health verification.

methods.name: EnsureConsul
methods.description: Checks if the Consul cluster is running; throws an exception if not.

methods.name: EnsureConsulAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously verifies if the Consul service is available by making an HTTP request.
